dependency.name: Prometheus
dependency.hash_recipe: SHA256 of canonical ASCII JSON sorted records {path,bytes,sha256} for src/**/*.lua, cli.lua and LICENSE; exact checked-out bytes
dependency.attribution: Based on Prometheus by Elias Oelschner, https://github.com/prometheus-lua/Prometheus

generated_exclusions.index.lua: Registry contains require paths, not CSV values; keep native module resolution transparent.
generated_exclusions.item_resources.lua: Separate generated executable resource resolver; require dedicated behavioral coverage before protecting.

optional_generated_string_obfuscation.runtime_math: Lexically scoped copy with private Park-Miller PRNG; no use of the gameplay RNG state.
optional_generated_string_obfuscation.allowed_scope: Generated pure table modules only; full exact-value verification is mandatory.

seed_rule: Positive deterministic per-source SHA256-derived seed; avoids upstream OpenSSL subprocess fallback.
failure_policy: Stop immediately, mark the new external candidate failed, do not substitute plaintext for a selected protected file.
claim: Offline Lua AST obfuscation. This is reverse-engineering friction, not cryptographic confidentiality.
